name: Craterback Descent
introDiscord:
"Impact craters overlap across the descending trench. Craterback Isopods roll through them like living meteors, apparently convinced every slope was created specifically for racing."

---------------- ROOM 1 — APPROACH ----------------
introTwitch:
"Impact craters overlap across the descending trench. Craterback Isopods roll through them like living meteors, apparently convinced every slope was created specifically for racing."

---------------- ROOM 1 — APPROACH ----------------

craterback-descent-approach.prompt: Three descending routes wind between impact pits. Fresh tracks suggest something round, armored, and extremely enthusiastic recently rolled through here.

left.message: A cometglass seam beneath a crater contains a stash of Star Candies. Tiny claw marks surround it like someone attempted excavation with enthusiasm instead of tools.

right.message: Shizuki left a restorative bottle inside an overturned meteor shell. The label reads: "Anti-rolling-down-a-hill medicine. Also works for normal injuries."
right.fullHpMessage: The bottle stays inside the shell. You haven't rolled down anything yet. Excellent start.

forward.message:
"A Craterback Isopod curls into a ball at the top of the slope.

There is a pause.

It rolls directly toward you.

Apparently you are the finish line."

---------------- ROOM 2 — DEPTHS ----------------

craterback-descent-depths.prompt: The descent steepens. Circular tracks cross every surface while three routes wind between increasingly enormous craters.

left.message:
A Craterback Isopod launches from a ledge, lands perfectly, and immediately charges.

You hate to admit it.

That entrance was impressive.

right.message:
A Berry has been carefully placed inside a tiny crater beside Shizuki's note:

"I tried racing one.

Do not ask who won.

Glimmer knows and has been forbidden from discussing it."

forward.message:
"A star-chart coffer sits at the bottom of a perfectly circular impact pit. Something has repeatedly rolled around it without figuring out how lids work."

---------------- ROOM 3 — THRESHOLD ----------------

craterback-descent-threshold.prompt: The final descent enters Impact-Shell Hollow. Three paths curve through enormous shell impressions pressed deep into the starstone.

left.message: A meteor-iron reliquary rests beneath an abandoned shell. The interior is completely intact despite several suspicious dents.

right.message:
A Craterback Isopod blocks the path.

It curls up.

You now recognize the pre-race pose.

forward.message: Shizuki's second emergency bottle rests behind a crater wall. The note reads: "For when gravity wins. Gravity wins often here."
forward.fullHpMessage:
"You leave Shizuki's emergency bottle untouched. Gravity has not defeated you today."

---------------- BOSS — IMPACT-SHELL HOLLOW ----------------

boss-antechamber.name: Impact-Shell Hollow
boss-antechamber.prompt: The smaller Isopods abruptly roll away from the hollow. A colossal armored shape shifts beneath the largest crater.

bossPromptDiscord:
The entire hollow trembles.

A shell larger than a wagon slowly rises from the crater floor.

Every nearby Craterback Isopod immediately stops racing.

Use /yes to enter Impact-Shell Hollow or /no to retreat while everyone is briefly behaving.
bossPromptTwitch:
The entire hollow trembles.

A shell larger than a wagon slowly rises from the crater floor.

Every nearby Craterback Isopod immediately stops racing.

Use !yes to enter Impact-Shell Hollow or !no to retreat while everyone is briefly behaving.
bossRetreatText: You retreat uphill. The smaller Isopods resume racing approximately three seconds later.

boss.revealText:
The enormous shell uncurls and claws strike the starstone.

Craterback Matriarch emerges!

completionText:
"The Matriarch settles back into the crater.

The smaller Isopods immediately resume rolling down every available slope.

Peace has been restored.

Their version of it, anyway."
